C1747.title: OWASP LLM03: Definition of Training Data Poisoning Risk
C1747.summary: The OWASP GenAI security project defines training data poisoning as an integrity attack where adversaries tamper with training data to impair a model's ability to produce correct predictions. This directly aligns with the risk description of attackers contaminating the training set to influence model behavior.
